step G67 of the content expansion, Magic Guard and Air Balloon (decision 0015 entry 5bl). Magic Guard (data/abilities.ts:2465-2476) blocks every damage whose Showdown effect is not a Move; the turn code classes every indirect damage with dfi_deal's required dfi_dmg_class (SIDE, WEATHER, STATUS, CONDITION, RECOIL and ITEM skipped silently by a holder, ABILITY skipped with -activate, DIRECT and MOVE taken, UNCLASSIFIED refused). The marks (both rows are engine rows, the switch-in line is the event kind 48), and each of the twelve battles of its list replays to its end with no refusal; test_conformance compares the HP and the lines of every step.
